description: Shared definition of the plan §4.5 Redacted(reason, commitment) value: purge shreds the key and replaces content with this typed stub; receipts referencing purged content remain structurally verifiable and report the redaction, downgrading per §18.4. Consumers (proof-receipt, context-pack, crashpack) inline an identical $defs named `redacted` mirroring this schema so each file stays self-contained.

commitment.description: Content commitment (hash) of the redacted original.

original_class.description: Artifact class of the redacted original (plan §4.4 prefix, e.g. crash, ctx, proof).
